page.layout: One page of text in a single column; a running head at the top; a table-like list of numbered observations with columns for Num./Praeceptor and Cap.Vf. (right side references); no separate margin notes beyond the right-hand reference column.

main_text.l: Observ. 512 Neque habebis qui consulunt mortuos. | ib. ii
main_text.p: N. obf.513 Debes omni Prophetæ obedire non addenti neque subtrahenti aliquid de lege Dei. Non observatur quia Christo repugnant. | ib. ii
main_text.l: Observ. 514 Non debes prophetizare falsum in nomine Dei. | ib. 20
Observ. 515 Non debes prophetizare in nomine Idoli.
main_text.p: N. obf.516 Obedies prophetæ cujus verba impleta sunt, quæ dixit ventura esse, hoc etiam illos pungit quia debe-rent Christo parere nec parent. | ib. 20
main_text.l: Observ. 517 Non impedies pœnam Pseudoprophetæ nec timebis illum. | ib. 20
N. obf. 518 Sex civitates separato in refugium. | ib. 19·36
Non 519 Non habebis misericordiam cum illo qui interfecit fratrem suum. | ib. 13
Observ. 520 Ne moveto terminum proximi tui quem majores determinaverunt, sive in terræ possessione sive in doctrinæ. | ib. 14

page.notes: Several marginal references and marks are partly illegible; the right-hand Cap./Vers. column is transcribed as printed as far as legible. Some words at the line ends (e.g. "Observ.", "Non") are uncertain.
